description:
Han-Gyeol , who was treated like a fool by his ex, ended up cheating on him after a long relationship. To console his empty heart, he decides to vacation in the countryside where he lived with his parents as a child. His damned ex-lover is too busy fucking someone else, so he feels heavy inside. Han-Gyeol, enjoying a relaxing masturbation session at home during his rare vacation, is caught by a strange man...?! But that man is Sung-Chan, the kid next door who used to play with him?

"You were the one who asked me to marry you first...!"

Sung-Chan presses him, mentioning a mysterious proposal Han-Gyeol made in the past. Well, I can't remember a thing about it!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
